muse.asks.continue.note: A Muse Code agent's status while it asks permission for something it doesn't name.

muse.asks.editFile.text: Muse asks to edit a file
muse.asks.editFile.note: A Muse Code agent's status while it asks permission to edit a file it doesn't name.

muse.asks.editFiles.note: A Muse Code agent's status while it asks permission to edit files. {files}: their paths, joined.

muse.asks.run.note: A Muse Code agent's status while it asks permission to run a command. {command}: its first line, shortened.

muse.asks.use.note: A Muse Code agent's status while it asks permission to use a tool. {tool}: the tool's name.

muse.guidance.pointer.text: Combwork's guidance for this session, this agent's instructions and the Workspace notes are too long for Muse's start context ({size} bytes; Muse keeps {max}). Read the whole file now, before anything else, and follow it as your instructions: {file}
muse.guidance.pointer.note: What a Muse Code agent reads at its start in place of its guidance, when that is over Muse’s limit: a pointer to the file holding it. {size} and {max} are byte counts, {file} a path.
